query:
SELECT 
  c.searchId,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.logoUrl IS NOT NULL AND c.logoUrl != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_logo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.logoUrl IS NULL OR c.logoUrl = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_logo
FROM companies c
WHERE c.searchId IN (1500003, 1350004)
GROUP BY c.searchId;
